title: $\eta_f$ is a morphism of ring objects
statement:
Give $f_*\Lambda_X$ the ring object structure induced by the lax monoidal
functor $f_*$ ([sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback]). Then
$\eta_f\colon\Lambda_Y\to f_*\Lambda_X$ ([def-sfb-eta]) is a morphism of ring
objects.

proof.text:
The adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$ is monoidal
([sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback]). So its unit is a monoidal natural
transformation, and its component $\Lambda_Y\to f_*f^*\Lambda_Y$ is a morphism
of ring objects. By [lem-sfb-alpha-ring-hom], $\alpha_f$ is a morphism of
ring objects, and the lax monoidal $f_*$ sends it to a morphism of ring
objects. A composite of morphisms of ring objects is one.
